architecture.style: Layered DDD (Domain-Driven Design) / Clean Architecture with OOP Domain
architecture.dependencyRule: Dependencies point strictly inwards: UI (p5 + DOM) -> Application -> Domain (Entities + Value Objects + Services). Domain has zero imports from outside PlatformGame/src/domain/ and zero references to p5 or browser globals.
architecture.paradigm: Object-Oriented Programming in the Domain (Aggregate Root, Entities, frozen Value Objects, composition over inheritance) paired with pure functions/modules in Domain Services, Application, and UI.

flows.title: Fixed-Timestep Frame Loop
flows.summary: Real frame deltaTime drives deterministic 1/30 s OOP physics and interpolated p5 rendering.

steps.label: p.draw() tick
steps.detail: p5 invokes draw(); game.ts clamps deltaTime to MAX_FRAME_SECONDS (0.1 s).

steps.label: Held directions
steps.detail: Arrow keys or touch pad update live getters in InputState { left, right, up }.

steps.label: world.step(dt, input)
steps.detail: Application hands elapsed seconds and InputState to the World Aggregate Root.

steps.label: planSteps(carry, dt)
steps.detail: Splits variable display time into whole 1/30 s steps plus interpolation alpha (0..1).

steps.label: fall() & move()
steps.detail: For each fixed step, Player applies gravity, horizontal input, jump boost, and view bounds.

steps.label: Immutable kinematics
steps.detail: velocity = velocity.add(GRAVITY); position = position.add(velocity) using frozen Vector instances.

steps.label: Interpolated draw
steps.detail: Interpolates previousPosition..position by alpha and draws sky, world, particles, player, and overlay.

flows.title: Collision & Bounce (Domain Service)
flows.summary: World delegates ball-vs-platform math to collision.ts so Player and Platform stay decoupled.

steps.label: resolveCollisions()
steps.detail: Passes player, readonly platforms[], and previous position into the domain service.

steps.label: platform.closestPoint()
steps.detail: Finds nearest point on each solid Platform rectangle to the ball's center.

steps.label: distanceTo() & normalOf()
steps.detail: Checks distance ≤ RADIUS and computes clock-face region (1..12) plus outward unit normal.

steps.label: land() or deflect
steps.detail: Top hit (side 3) bounces vy × -1.05 (capped at 20); side/corner hits deflect velocity and push out.

steps.label: CollisionResult
steps.detail: Returns { landingSpeed, wallHit, side, normal }, merged into world.lastStep.

flows.title: App Boot & Level Generation
flows.summary: Composition root wires DOM panels, p5 sketch, controls, and initial procedural World.

steps.label: DOM ready / pageshow
steps.detail: main.ts preloads Instrument Sans font for canvas and locates stage, pad, panel, and learn slots.

steps.label: mountLearnPanels()
steps.detail: Mounts Physics & Architecture DOM panels and returns the per-frame onFrame callback.

steps.label: mountPlatformGame()
steps.detail: Passes DOM slots and panels.onFrame into the Application layer.

steps.label: generateWorld()
steps.detail: Creates 14 random Platforms separated by 130-unit gaps.

steps.label: new World(platforms)
steps.detail: Instantiates the World Aggregate Root with Platforms and a fresh Player.

steps.label: attachControls()
steps.detail: Binds Arrow keys, blur release, and touch pad buttons with wake() callback.

steps.label: mountSketch() & Ui
steps.detail: Mounts p5 instance with ResizeObserver and Pause / New level toolbar.

flows.title: Landing Juice & Particles
flows.summary: Dust bursts, squash-and-stretch, flash, and screen shake live strictly outside Domain.

steps.label: world.lastStep report
steps.detail: Exposes landingSpeed and wallHit without knowing anything about animations or FX.

steps.label: burst() & stepParticles()
steps.detail: Spawns warm dust on landing (> 2) or white sparks on wallHit unless prefersReducedMotion is set.

steps.label: fadeEffects()
steps.detail: Smoothly eases overlay visibility via approach() and decays squash, flash, and shake.

steps.label: drawParticles & Player
steps.detail: Renders fading particles, squashed ball ellipse, white flash lerp, and camera shake.

flows.title: Live Learn Panels Telemetry
flows.summary: Explanatory DOM panels observe Domain output every frame without Domain coupling.

steps.label: onFrame(world, input, dt)
steps.detail: Called at the end of every p5 draw() frame with current World and InputState.

steps.label: Read lastStep & player
steps.detail: architecture.ts and physics.ts inspect world.lastStep, velocity, and contact side read-only.

steps.label: Highlight active layers
steps.detail: Updates DOM status text and lights up whichever DDD layers acted during that frame.

flows.title: DDD Purity Guardrail (Vitest)
flows.summary: Automated test prevents accidental p5, DOM, or outward imports inside src/domain/.

steps.label: Scan src/domain/*.ts
steps.detail: Reads every non-test TypeScript file in src/domain/ from disk.

steps.label: Forbid p5 & DOM globals
steps.detail: Asserts no file mentions p5, document, window, HTMLElement, or navigator.

steps.label: Enforce inward imports
steps.detail: Asserts every import specifier matches /^\.\/[a-z-]+\.ts$/ (domain siblings only).
